verdict.rationale: Metorial's docs describe connecting agents to multiple providers/tools in a session, tool filters, and sample bots (standup, interview coordinator), but there is no documented batch/bulk-operation capability—no bulk API endpoints, no evidence of invoking a tool across many items in one call, or a bulk-processing feature. missing for 10: batch/bulk API or endpoint, evidence of processing many items in a single agent action, any explicit 'bulk operations' documentation.
